units.rawText: Ah, greetings, Professor. Have you finished your meeting with Sangoma? Has she brought any news? Also, Professor, would you mind talking about the story of when we started building the Oasis? I heard your memory...

units.rawText: Eh-hehe~ I also revealed my true identity to everyone at the Oasis today. Thankfully, no one was angry about my dishonesty, and it seems many of them had already figured it out... (sob)

units.rawText: The Oasis is such a wonderful place... Uh, not saying Arcadia is worse, or the previous oil well was bad or anything! It's just that the Oasis has this unique vibe... Yeah, a very, very special vibe!
